verdict.rationale: Trello documents a REST API with API keys, tokens, batch, search and webhook endpoints, so documented rate limits are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack states any rate limits, request quotas, or concurrency caps. Auth and endpoint listings are adjacent material and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale
